name: Abbotswood Park Play Area
text: A scenic site with plenty of planting, a junior multi-play unit, cradle, basket and gyro spiral swings, a roundabout and a balance beam.

name: Ann Shaw Gardens Play Area
text: A new play area with a junior multi-play, cradle and basket swings, a roundabout, children's seating and picnic area, with parking at Henbury Way car park.

name: Ashburnham Drive Play Area
text: An adventure playground with zip wires between trees, climbing nets, a climbing wall, suspension bridge, trampoline and inclusive swings, hammock, embankment slide and roundabout.

name: Ashridge Play Area (Prestwick Road)
text: A woodland playscape with den-making and log bridges, a junior multi-play, slide, spring rockers and inclusive cradle swings.

name: Baldwins Lane Play Area
text: One of the council's flagship adventure playgrounds, with a zip wire, junior multi-play, suspension bridge, crawling tunnel, embankment slide, inclusive basket roundabout and swings.

name: Barton Way Play Area
text: A wild play area with a sandy landscape, tree house climbing unit, zip wire, net climb and trampoline; the council page said it was being refurbished and would reopen on 26 March 2026, so equipment may have changed.

name: Beechen Wood Play Area
text: A well-equipped play area with open space, a toddler multi-play, slide, seesaw, flat swings and an inclusive roundabout and cradle swings.

name: Cassiobridge Play Area
text: Swings and play units for toddlers and young children, plus an activity trail and 5-a-side goal area for older children, behind a self-closing gate.

name: Denham Way Play Area
text: A comprehensive play area in playing fields with toddler and junior multi-play, basket, toddler and flat swings, a seesaw, crawling tunnel mound and roundabout.

name: Dowding Way Play Area
text: A small, secure playground for younger children with a toddler play unit, spring animal and toddler swings.

name: Eastbury Play Area
text: Designed with local schoolchildren, it has a tower with den and slide, a rope and log tangle, a willow tunnel and inclusive cradle swings, spinner bowl and basket swing.

name: Fearney Mead Play Area
text: A smaller play area for toddlers and young children with a multi-play unit and slide, behind a self-closing gate.

name: Gade View Gardens Play Area
text: A small site with an inclusive basket swing and a multi-play unit with a slide.

name: Greenfields Avenue Play Area
text: Managed by Watford Rural Parish Council; has climbing trees, balance logs, a slide, trampoline, mound with bridge, zip wire, toddler swing and inclusive basket and jungle swings.

name: Hayling Road Play Area
text: A zip wire, climbing unit, climbing wall, sand play, maze, willow tunnel, toddler swings and inclusive basket swing, hammock and roundabout; the council says it is due for refurbishment.

name: Hornhill Play Area
text: A play area with a zip wire, climbing unit, trampoline, balance logs, toddler swings and an inclusive roundabout, basket swing and slide.

name: King George V Play Area
text: A wide range of equipment at the playing fields, including junior and senior multi-play, a zip wire, trampoline, adventure trail and inclusive swings, slide, sand play and roundabout.

name: Langley Lane Play Area
text: A scenic site with sensory garden planting, a junior multi-play unit, cradle seat swings, a slide, spring rockers and a balance beam.

name: Leavesden Country Park Play Area
text: A large play space with a tower, slide, crawling tunnels, flying carpet swing, toddler and basket swings, disc roundabout, aeroplane climber and junior multi-play, with Woodlands Café and toilets in the country park.

name: Lemonfield Drive Play Area
text: Managed by Abbots Langley Parish Council. Has inclusive play panels, junior and toddler swings, a multi-play unit and slide, a balance trail, spring rockers, a spring seesaw and a whizzer.

name: Lincoln Drive Play Area
text: A pleasant site the council describes as having inclusive play equipment, with a multi-play unit, spring horse and slide.

name: Manor House Grounds Play Area
text: Managed by Abbots Langley Parish Council. Has toddler, junior and inclusive swings, an inclusive roundabout, zip wire, embankment slide, woodland climbing frame, play tower with tube slide and climbing nets.

name: Moortown Road Play Area
text: A small, well-equipped play area with a toddler multi-play, basket swing, spring see-saw, roundabout and slide.

name: Oaklands Avenue Play Area
text: A colourful area among trees and plants with a junior multi-play, spring rockers, a balance beam and inclusive cradle swings and slide.

name: Oulton Way Play Area
text: Challenging equipment including a zip wire, net climber, crawling tunnel, sand excavator, and inclusive cradle swings, roundabout, sand pit and trampoline.

name: Ovaltine Play Area
text: Managed by Notting Hill Genesis housing association; has spring animals, a toddler swing, panel maze, multi-play unit with slide, balance beam and seesaw.

name: Rickmansworth Aquadrome Play Space
text: A nature-themed play area built from natural tree trunks, with net and step climbers and crawl spaces, near the Aquadrome café and toilets.

name: Scotsbridge Play Area
text: A landscaped playground with grassy knolls, a zip wire, trampoline, space net, gyro spiral and inclusive swings, slide, dish roundabout and sand play.

name: Skidmore Way Play Area
text: A small play area with spring rockers, a cradle seat swing and a climbing frame.

name: South Way Play Area
text: Managed by Abbots Langley Parish Council. Has a balance trail, dish roundabout, jungle climber, trampoline, zip wire, sand pit, slide and swings, with an outdoor gym nearby.
